events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Five Manhattan bodegas; see practical notes
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas and delis, with eight chefs serving complimentary CookUnity meals and hot bites during lunch.
events.what_is_free: Anyone who walks into a participating location can receive a complimentary chef-made CookUnity dish while supplies last. Guests also receive a bodega-style scratch-off for chances to win additional CookUnity meals or dining experiences.
events.caveats: Multiple current NYC sources independently agree on the September 17 date, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM window, five participating Manhattan locations and open-public free-meal format. A dedicated first-party CookUnity event page was not surfaced in this pass, so the listing does not invent an RSVP or registration requirement. Food and scratch-off inventory are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM. Participating locations: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave. Walk in; no RSVP is stated in the corroborating current listings.

events.address: The Brant Foundation Gallery, 421 E 6th St, New York, NY 10009
events.what_it_is: An immersive forest of flat-pack wooden sculpture by Cj Hendry and Sulwhasoo, inspired by the hidden garden at The House of Sulwhasoo in Seoul.
events.what_is_free: Verified current event listings describe the September 18–20 public viewing window and do not publish a ticket, RSVP or organizer-approval requirement.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center's current Cj Hendry feature independently confirms that Secret Garden with Sulwhasoo runs at the Brant Foundation September 17–20. Current NYC event listings identify the open-to-the-public viewing window as September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM. Because the verified sources reviewed here do not explicitly state an admission price, this listing does not label the experience as a guaranteed free event.
events.practical_notes: Public viewing is listed Friday through Sunday, September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM at The Brant Foundation Gallery, 421 E 6th Street. No advance RSVP or ticket requirement is stated in the verified current public listings.

events.event_name: Happy Camp3r — The Sweetest Stop in NYC
events.what_it_is: Happy Camp3r's first NYC pop-up, combining comfort-focused fashion retail with sweet treats, photo moments, exclusive experiences and weekend surprises.
events.what_is_free: Entry to the public pop-up is free. Current event listings advertise sweet treats, photo moments and surprises, but do not guarantee a specific free item to every visitor.
events.caveats: Parasol Projects currently confirms Happy Camp3r at 251 Elizabeth Street during the September 14–20 booking window. Current public-event listings independently identify the consumer-facing pop-up hours as September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM, and describe it as open to the public. The wider venue booking window is not treated as public operating hours.
events.practical_notes: Friday through Sunday, September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM at 251 Elizabeth Street. Walk-in public retail activation; merchandise is for purchase and any treats/surprises are availability-dependent.
